questions.stem: A 25 year old male presents with exertional dyspnea and chest pain while playing table tennis. Echocardiography shows systolic anterior movement of mitral valve with LV free wall thickness of 30 mm. He informs you about the sudden death of his elder brother while dancing at a marriage party. Which of the following is the best intervention for management of this patient?
